scope: Sampled PageRank screen for deciding whether proposal-faithful K2-M merits full-graph and all-kernel evaluation.

semantic_receipt_provenance.reason_for_t0: Disable convergence-based early exit so requested and executed iteration counts match.
semantic_receipt_provenance.cross_isa_check: The three i=1 host receipts independently match retained RISC-V gem5 rows.

popt_model.note: Triple buffering permits overlap of column e+2 while e and e+1 remain readable. It favors P-OPT timing but costs one additional LLC way versus a two-slot design in these cells. A two-slot serialized sensitivity is mandatory before a P-OPT performance claim.

blockers.reason: Validate one O3 row using the implemented compact_trace_free mode. It executes the same architectural 4-byte StreamShield record load and request-bound K2-M property load as the committed correctness gate, but leaves both per-event trace limits at zero. The row must emit the proposal activation and compact field-width receipt, match PageRank semantics, and remain timing-valid.

Implement target-time matrix streaming, initial residency, per-iteration reload, and requestor-scoped counters. Receipts must report the SSOT engine settings: two demanded columns, memory-to-reserved-LLC stream path, L1/L2 bypass, demand priority, 32 maximum outstanding requests, per-iteration reload, initial columns charged in ROI, and no conventional prefetcher. Keep popt_matrix_stream_bytes as one-iteration metadata; emit cumulative popt_target_stream_bytes, popt_matrix_stream_requests, popt_matrix_stream_dram_bytes, popt_stream_requestor_dram_bytes, and non-stream DRAM bytes for the executed run. The uncharged control emits the same accounting fields with zero or none values.
LRU, GRASP, and P-OPT must complete the same O3 preflight. GRASP must emit context-loaded and hot-property access counters; P-OPT must emit context/rereference-loaded and oracle-query counters.
Produce request-bound O3 correctness evidence for the online set-dueling arm.
Produce one timing-admissible online O3 row with the expected rrip_first/dueling receipt.
Approve 12 whole-cell seven-policy jobs; policy sharding is not allowed.

execution.note: Stages remain blocked until the performance mode and P-OPT target-time engine are implemented.

resource_scope.screen: K2 uses equal data capacity; charged P-OPT loses reserved LLC ways for its matrix.

charged_in_roi.popt: reserved LLC capacity, matrix-stream traffic, and target time

disclosed_hardware.k2: 49 metadata bits/line, request sideband, CSRs, StreamShield flag, and online dueling state

sampling_caveat: The sampled graphs overcharge P-OPT stream bytes per edge relative to the available full graphs, while their smaller vertex IDs also allow K2's 4-byte compact record to fit. Full-graph expansion may require a wider K2 encoding. A screen result is not a full-graph or all-kernel claim.
compact_record_feasibility: Every sampled graph must satisfy id_bits + 2 tier bits + 2*epoch_bits <= 32. Full-graph expansion must re-check the encoding.
